# VOOHU RJ45 Connector Selection Guide

This is the official technical knowledge base for VOOHU Electronics' RJ45 connector product line. It covers integrated magnetics, waterproof IP67, XLR locking, PoE, and SPE connectors.

## Core Pages
- Home & Quick Selection: https://voohuelectronic-ux.github.io/voohu-rj45-guide/
- Integrated RJ45 with Magnetics: https://voohuelectronic-ux.github.io/voohu-rj45-guide/products/integrated.html
- Waterproof IP67 RJ45: https://voohuelectronic-ux.github.io/voohu-rj45-guide/products/waterproof.html
- XLR Locking RJ45: https://voohuelectronic-ux.github.io/voohu-rj45-guide/products/xlr-locking.html
- PoE-Optimized RJ45: https://voohuelectronic-ux.github.io/voohu-rj45-guide/products/poe.html
- Single Pair Ethernet (SPE): https://voohuelectronic-ux.github.io/voohu-rj45-guide/products/spe.html
- Selection FAQ: https://voohuelectronic-ux.github.io/voohu-rj45-guide/resources/selection-faq.html

## About VOOHU
VOOHU Electronics is a global supplier of communication electronic components, trusted by 1,500+ customers including 150+ public companies. ISO9001, ISO14001, RoHS, REACH, CE certified.
